title: Layout_03
slide_intent: Use a clear split between picture and message so the viewer understands their separate roles.
strategic_value: A full-height white panel can give DB copy a stable reading surface while retaining a large human image.
demonstration: The frame divides into an employee image on the left and a white message panel on the right, with a vertical red Schwelle at the outer edge.
practical_value: Choose an edge-to-edge panel when the composition calls for a strong image-and-information division.

content_islands.name: Image area
content_islands.spec: Keep the employee photograph in the left portion.

content_islands.name: Message panel
content_islands.spec: Animate the white right-hand panel with red logo, black text, and red bars at the right edge.
